limitations: Not a wall-clock CPU or input-to-display latency benchmark.
No native window, compositor, GPU presentation, Discord account or physical input device is exercised.
Timeline positions are covered separately by the production TimelineScenario UI regression.
Completion occurs on the first scheduled frame at/after the 150 ms deadline; overruns are bounded by one frame interval.
Opposite-direction residual distance is intentionally retired on reversal, and is reported separately.
The palette helper is a stub; the scroll module and egui input processing are production code.
scroll.method: Deterministic RawInput through the actual pinned-egui production scroll adapter; public delta captured before a scroll-area consumer.
scroll.precision: Software coordinates, not physical device events.
assertions: Same-direction line input retains total movement within 0.01 pt of f32 accumulation.
Direction reversal produces movement in the new direction on the same software frame.
Smooth-off, precision point and OS momentum inputs are delivered without another smoothing tail.
Completion is no later than the first available frame after the 150 ms deadline.
Each case evaluates at most 160 frames; only input and completion/idle samples are retained.

followup_2026_10_22.source_note: All measurements and screenshots refer to the frozen runtime source, not a later evidence-only commit. Previous top-level measurements remain historical at their original revisions.
implementation: Immutable per-frame timezone/clock snapshot; cached minute-level settings label/example; no settings-page timer while hidden or minimized.
Incremental reply-preview payload bytes and one resident-total calculation per enforcement pass; empty-cache invalidation fast path.
Validated channel lookup reuse for acknowledgements and no edit-only timeline lookup when no optimistic edit is pending.
Typed, owner-bound message/link/image menus; child hit testing; requested ordering; bounded keyboard/submenu handling and leading icon columns.
Existing reminders and bot commands, local platform speech, bounded interaction details and an explicit service-driven unofficial reporting flow.

native_method.command: cargo rustc --release --locked -p serein --no-default-features --features demo --example profile_preview -- -C lto=thin
native_method.release_settings: O3, one codegen unit, thin-LTO override; all three examples share the same bounded fixture/instrumentation overlay and Inter fonts.
native_method.renderer: wgpu GL on llvmpipe (LLVM 19.1.7, Mesa 25.0.7-2+deb13u1); natural-idle runs do not enable callback metrics.
native_method.artifact_note: Verified frozen fork and starting-PR artifacts were reused; the final UI binary was built once after runtime changes settled. No compilation or packaging ran during the final uninstrumented comparisons.
native_method.limits: Synthetic demo activity can still repaint; not an idle connected account. Five per-run callback percentiles are summarized by their median, not pooled. No physical display/input latency, GPU memory or live Discord throughput claim. No provider process was started; observed helper RSS was zero.

allocation_diagnostics.interpretation: Initial instrumented counts were unequal while other task work was running (24 versus 112/116 callbacks). A separate quiet diagnostic observed 111/114/122 callbacks and 42/44 wheel events. Requested-byte traffic per callback is similar; do not treat raw lower totals, instrumented CPU or nonaligned windows as an allocation improvement. No additional GIF optimization was retained on this evidence.
